description: Na₂CrO₄ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with three equivalent CrO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one CrO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.50 Å. Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-1.68 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Cr atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one Cr atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Cr atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Cr atom.
